name: POX Begonia Kernel

tutorial.title: Verify Firmware & Recovery
tutorial.instruction: Ensure your device is running a compatible Android base and custom recovery (TWRP, OrangeFox, PBRP, or SHRP).

tutorial.title: Backup Existing Boot Partition
tutorial.instruction: Take a full nandroid backup of your current boot/kernel partition in recovery before flashing.

tutorial.title: Flash Kernel AnyKernel3 Zip
tutorial.instruction: Flash the Pox Kernel AnyKernel3 zip via ADB sideload or the recovery file manager.

tutorial.title: Reboot System
tutorial.instruction: Reboot to system and verify kernel version under Settings -> About Phone.

features.title: Rock Editions Matrix
features.text: Curated branch matrix (Granite, Obsidian, Onyx) built on upstreamed Linux 4.14 stable LTS.

features.title: Multi-Root Support
features.text: Native builds with integrated KernelSU-Next, APatch, Sultan debloat, and Magisk compatibility.

features.title: Zero Frame-Drop Engine
features.text: Tuned energy-aware scheduling, optimized thermal profiles, and 240Hz touch gaming debounce.

changelog.title: Mainline Release with Sultan Debloat, KernelSU-Next & Safe USB 500mA Charging
changelog.summary: Major stability and performance release featuring Xiaomi Power HAL panic immunization, zero-overhead storage scheduler, and upstream KernelSU-Next legacy driver.
changes: Zero EL1 Aborts: Resolved Xiaomi Power HAL NodeLooperThread fatal panic by preserving sysctl_sched_migration_cost as writable in .data.
Storage I/O Optimization: Default UFS block storage scheduler tuned to zero-overhead noop for flash memory.
Motherboard Protection: Standard PC USB host ports clamped to 500mA USB 2.0 SDP to eliminate ADB disconnect loops and protect host motherboards.
Fast Charging: Full MediaTek Pump Express PE+ 2.0 dual-phase fast charging (up to 3.0A / 18W) on AC chargers.
KernelSU-Next legacy tip refresh with in-tree SUSFS v2.3.0 path/mount hiding and local SELinux hide backport.
Zero Frame-Drop Engine: Tuned energy-aware scheduler (EAS) and 240Hz gaming debounce.
Ported MediaTek VCU and V4L2 Codec2 hardware decoding/encoding engine from S vendor release.

changelog.title: Initial Mainline Public Beta Release
changelog.summary: Public beta bringup establishing the Rock Editions kernel matrix on upstreamed Linux 4.14 LTS.
changes: Initial Rock Editions matrix release (Granite, Obsidian, Onyx) for Redmi Note 8 Pro.
Integrated multi-root support with APatch, KernelSU-Next, and Magisk compatibility.
Embedded FolkPatch auto-installer inside flashable recovery AnyKernel3 packages.
